item.title: Self-Hosted API Gateway Management: Kong Manager vs Tyk Dashboard vs Gravitee Console (2026)
item.description: Deploying an API gateway is only the first step. Once your gateway is running, you need tools to configure routes, manage plugins, monitor traffic, and control access — all without editing YAML files or making raw API calls. The leading open-source API gateways each ship with dedicated management interfaces: Kong Manager, Tyk Dashboard, and Gravitee API Management Console.
